dedupe_keys.name: lyon parcel delivery model inputs synthetic population and parcel depots

description: This dataset contains the inputs of a replicable modelling pipeline for analysing policies on last-mile parcel deliveries in the city of Lyon, France. It provides synthetic populations of the study area around Lyon produced by the open eqasim pipeline, describing the sociodemographic attributes and home locations of synthetic persons for 2019, 2024 and 2030 at a 100 percent sample, together with a dataset of semi-automatically derived depot locations of parcel operators in the Lyon metropolitan area. It was published by Sebastian Hörl of IRT SystemX on 15 October 2024. Coverage is regional (the Lyon metropolitan area), at the level of individual synthetic persons and individual depots. The files are free on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0: person tables in CSV and home locations in GeoPackage for each year (about 250 MB each) and a small GeoPackage of prepared depot data. Caveats: the population is synthetic, the depot list was derived semi-automatically, and the delivery demand model itself is not part of the record. The data support agent-based simulation of parcel demand and delivery tours, capacity planning of depots and network flow studies of urban freight, and relate to agent-based models such as MATSim catalogued here.
